title: Picking an inactive part in global search from the Active tab switches to Inactive, no tab in the URL
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-I1 is inactive here.
custom_steps:
1. Open Parts > Inventory, stay on the Active tab and type "QAPL-T" in the search box.
  2. Press Ctrl+K and type "QAPL-I1".
  3. Select the QAPL-I1 row.
  4. Look at the address bar.
  5. Refresh the page.
custom_expected:
1. The Active tab lists QAPL-T1 to QAPL-T5; the URL has no tab= parameter.
  2. Global search lists QAPL-I1 with a grey "Inactive" tag.
  3. The Inventory list switches from Active to the Inactive tab, the search box now reads QAPL-I1 (replacing "QAPL-T"), and QAPL-I1 is listed.
  4. The URL carries no tab= parameter.
  5. Inventory opens on the Active tab.
